# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Wednesday, November 11, 2026

Morning edition for Wednesday, 11 November 2026 (IST). Covers Tuesday 10 Nov, a trading holiday on NSE and BSE, and overnight. Stock and index closes below are still Monday's, the latest official files.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs start trading on BSE today
BSE notice 20261109-30, dated 9 Nov, says Muthoot Fincorp's secured redeemable NCDs are admitted to dealings from Wednesday 11 November 2026 in the "F" group, in demat form with a market lot of one bond. The notice names Integrated Registry Management Services as registrar.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the listing date for the issue is now set; the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.
Source: [BSE notice 20261109-30](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)

### Update: IIFL Finance board approves a ₹6,414 crore raise led by Blackstone
IIFL's board approved on 10 Nov a preferential issue of CCPS and warrants at ₹602 each: Blackstone funds put in ₹5,000 crore for about 16% fully diluted, promoters ₹1,264 crore through warrants and Anchorage Capital ₹150 crore. ET says IIFL expects its capital adequacy to rise from about 17% to about 30% pro forma for September 2026, and that it plans to use the money to grow secured lending, particularly gold finance.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: IIFL Finance is a listed gold-loan competitor that has now stated a gold-loan growth plan backed by fresh equity, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; the ₹602 issue price is also a recent valuation reference for a gold-focused NBFC ahead of Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/iifl-finance-to-raise-rs-6414-crore-through-preferential-issue-blackstone-to-invest-rs-5000-crore/articleshow/135711113.cms)

### Gold falls about 2.7% after a hot US inflation print
Reuters reported spot gold down 2.7% at $4,028.39 an ounce at 1:53 pm ET on Tuesday, after US CPI rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast. Bets on a 50 bp Fed hike in December rose to about 10% from zero, according to CME FedWatch as cited by Reuters.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: IBJA's 10 Nov AM rate was published before the fall, and AGLOC's 11 Nov per-gram ceilings are unchanged; a lower rupee gold price would reduce collateral values across gold-loan books, including Muthoot Fincorp's.
Source: [Reuters via Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/gold-falls-nearly-3-as-cpi-tops-forecasts-lifting-dollar-and-yields-11794337899940.html)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs are admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026 in the "F" group; the final allotted amount has not been seen in a published source. The ₹500 crore issue (₹200 crore base plus ₹300 crore green shoe) closed on 5 Nov with bids at 2.67x, and carries CRISIL AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable ratings with coupons of 8.56%–9.25%.
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026, "F" group ([BSE notice](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)) | 2026-11-11 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe); final allotted amount not seen in a published source | 2026-11-11 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-11 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-11 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov; BSE shows 53,36,597 NCDs bid against 20,00,000 base (266.83%) ([BSE bid data](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-05 |

The BSE listing is covered as the lead story above. Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, didn't trade on Tuesday (holiday); its last close was ₹159.73 on 9 Nov ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_09112026.csv)).

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Markets shut on Tuesday; Monday's closes stand
NSE and BSE were closed on 10 Nov, and NSE has published no index file for that date, so Monday's closes are the latest: Nifty 50 at 25,044.65 and Nifty Financial Services at 27,384.90. Among gold lenders, Muthoot Finance last closed at ₹2,917.60, Manappuram at ₹323.75 and IIFL Finance at ₹627.00.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: 11 Nov is the first trading session after IIFL Finance's capital-raise approval and Tuesday's fall in gold prices.
Source: [NSE index closes 9 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_09112026.csv)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### No new NBFC circular on 10 Nov
RBI's 10 Nov press releases were a G-sec auction notice, SDL auction results and an extension of the Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank board supersession; the notifications feed still ends on 5 Nov. SEBI's 10 Nov items are recovery-proceeding orders only.
Source: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No significant developments today. Manappuram's Q2 call is on 12 Nov, and listed-debt Q2 results under Reg 52 are due by 14 Nov.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Bajaj Finance allots ₹5,799 crore of warrants to Bajaj Finserv
A board committee of Bajaj Finance allotted 5,74,25,740 warrants to promoter Bajaj Finserv on 10 Nov at ₹1,010 each, about ₹5,799.9 crore in all, PTI reported. A quarter of the money is payable at allotment and the rest when the warrants are converted into shares.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: two large listed NBFCs added fresh equity on the same day, which forms part of the peer backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO.
Source: [BusinessLine (PTI)](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/bajaj-finance-issues-574-cr-warrants-to-promoter-for-5799-cr/article71685893.ece)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

### Piramal Finance CEO says the new co-lending rules may end upfront-monetisation models
In an ETBFSI interview published on 10 Nov, Piramal Finance MD and CEO Jairam Sridharan said originators that book the present value of future co-lending cash flows as upfront profit may not survive the new framework. He said Piramal's co-lending book is about ₹5,000 crore, growing 20–25% a year, and that it participates mainly as the investor.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Muthoot Microfin has reported gold loans sourced through referrals and co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp, so the treatment of co-lent loans is relevant to both companies.
Source: [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/piramal-finance-ceo-says-new-co-lending-norms-may-impact-upfront-loan-monetisation-models/135697169)

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance

### HFCs turn to construction finance for yield
Financial Express reports LIC Housing Finance expects its project-loan book, ₹9,740 crore at 30 September, to reach ₹15,000 crore by March, and PNB Housing has restarted construction finance with a ₹10,000–11,000 crore target over three years. FE cites RBI data showing NBFC and HFC credit to commercial real estate up 23.4% year on year to ₹1,05,845 crore in September 2026, with construction-finance yields of 13–15%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: its subsidiary Muthoot Housing Finance operates in retail housing finance, the segment FE describes as thin-margin.
Source: [Financial Express](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/banking-finance-hfcs-lean-towards-realty-construction-finance-4380301/)

### Godrej Housing Finance targets a ₹10,000 crore affordable book by 2031
Godrej Housing Finance told Mint on 9 Nov that its affordable-housing AUM is ₹600 crore across 52 branches, with an average ticket under ₹20 lakh, and that it wants ₹10,000 crore by 2031. Its total AUM has crossed ₹10,000 crore, of which prime home loans are ₹8,500 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a group-backed lender expanding affordable housing in tier 2 and 3 towns adds competition in the segment served by its subsidiary Muthoot Housing Finance.
Source: [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/godrej-housing-finance-targets-10-000-crore-affordable-loan-book-by-2031-11794200509961.html)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Wednesday, 11 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

✅ No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND instrument for NBFCs on 10 Nov, a market holiday. One exchange notice concerns Muthoot Fincorp: its NCDs list today.

### BSE admits Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs to dealings from 11 Nov
BSE notice 20261109-30 (DCS-Listing, 9 Nov) admits Muthoot Fincorp's secured redeemable NCDs to dealings from 11 Nov 2026 in the "F" group, demat only, market lot of one bond. It's an exchange notice, not a circular, so it gets no reg block.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the issue's listing step is complete; the deemed date of allotment and final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.
Source: [BSE notice 20261109-30](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 10 Nov
RBI's notifications feed still ends with the 5 Nov items. Its 10 Nov press releases are a GoI dated-security auction notice, SDL auction results and an extension of the Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank board supersession. SEBI's 10 Nov feed has only recovery-proceeding notices and prohibitory orders, and its last circular is still dated 5 Nov. NHB's newest notice is still 4 Nov, and the IBBI and FIU-IND pages gave no date this run that could be parsed, while searches turned up no new IBBI or FIU-IND instrument.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new regulatory item. Dates already on the calendar include the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov comment deadline on RBI's draft PSL Directions.
Source: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx)

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs start trading on BSE today
cards.summary: BSE notice 20261109-30, dated 9 Nov, says Muthoot Fincorp's secured redeemable NCDs are admitted to dealings from Wednesday 11 November 2026 in the "F" group, in demat form with a market lot of one bond. The notice names Integrated Registry Management Services as registrar.
cards.impact: the listing date for the issue is now set; the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.

cards.title: Update: IIFL Finance board approves a ₹6,414 crore raise led by Blackstone
cards.summary: IIFL's board approved on 10 Nov a preferential issue of CCPS and warrants at ₹602 each: Blackstone funds put in ₹5,000 crore for about 16% fully diluted, promoters ₹1,264 crore through warrants and Anchorage Capital ₹150 crore. ET says IIFL expects its capital adequacy to rise from about 17% to about 30% pro forma for September 2026, and that it plans to use the money to grow secured lending, particularly gold finance.
cards.impact: IIFL Finance is a listed gold-loan competitor that has now stated a gold-loan growth plan backed by fresh equity, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; the ₹602 issue price is also a recent valuation reference for a gold-focused NBFC ahead of Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.

cards.title: Gold falls about 2.7% after a hot US inflation print
cards.summary: Reuters reported spot gold down 2.7% at $4,028.39 an ounce at 1:53 pm ET on Tuesday, after US CPI rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast. Bets on a 50 bp Fed hike in December rose to about 10% from zero, according to CME FedWatch as cited by Reuters.
cards.impact: IBJA's 10 Nov AM rate was published before the fall, and AGLOC's 11 Nov per-gram ceilings are unchanged; a lower rupee gold price would reduce collateral values across gold-loan books, including Muthoot Fincorp's.

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
cards.summary: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs are admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026 in the "F" group; the final allotted amount has not been seen in a published source. The ₹500 crore issue (₹200 crore base plus ₹300 crore green shoe) closed on 5 Nov with bids at 2.67x, and carries CRISIL AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable ratings with coupons of 8.56%–9.25%.

cards.title: Markets shut on Tuesday; Monday's closes stand
cards.summary: NSE and BSE were closed on 10 Nov, and NSE has published no index file for that date, so Monday's closes are the latest: Nifty 50 at 25,044.65 and Nifty Financial Services at 27,384.90. Among gold lenders, Muthoot Finance last closed at ₹2,917.60, Manappuram at ₹323.75 and IIFL Finance at ₹627.00.
cards.impact: 11 Nov is the first trading session after IIFL Finance's capital-raise approval and Tuesday's fall in gold prices.

cards.title: Bajaj Finance allots ₹5,799 crore of warrants to Bajaj Finserv
cards.summary: A board committee of Bajaj Finance allotted 5,74,25,740 warrants to promoter Bajaj Finserv on 10 Nov at ₹1,010 each, about ₹5,799.9 crore in all, PTI reported. A quarter of the money is payable at allotment and the rest when the warrants are converted into shares.
cards.impact: two large listed NBFCs added fresh equity on the same day, which forms part of the peer backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO.

cards.title: Piramal Finance CEO says the new co-lending rules may end upfront-monetisation models
cards.summary: In an ETBFSI interview published on 10 Nov, Piramal Finance MD and CEO Jairam Sridharan said originators that book the present value of future co-lending cash flows as upfront profit may not survive the new framework. He said Piramal's co-lending book is about ₹5,000 crore, growing 20–25% a year, and that it participates mainly as the investor.
cards.impact: Muthoot Microfin has reported gold loans sourced through referrals and co-lending with Muthoot Fincorp, so the treatment of co-lent loans is relevant to both companies.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: HFCs turn to construction finance for yield
cards.summary: Financial Express reports LIC Housing Finance expects its project-loan book, ₹9,740 crore at 30 September, to reach ₹15,000 crore by March, and PNB Housing has restarted construction finance with a ₹10,000–11,000 crore target over three years. FE cites RBI data showing NBFC and HFC credit to commercial real estate up 23.4% year on year to ₹1,05,845 crore in September 2026, with construction-finance yields of 13–15%.
cards.impact: its subsidiary Muthoot Housing Finance operates in retail housing finance, the segment FE describes as thin-margin.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: Godrej Housing Finance targets a ₹10,000 crore affordable book by 2031
cards.summary: Godrej Housing Finance told Mint on 9 Nov that its affordable-housing AUM is ₹600 crore across 52 branches, with an average ticket under ₹20 lakh, and that it wants ₹10,000 crore by 2031. Its total AUM has crossed ₹10,000 crore, of which prime home loans are ₹8,500 crore.
cards.impact: a group-backed lender expanding affordable housing in tier 2 and 3 towns adds competition in the segment served by its subsidiary Muthoot Housing Finance.
